name: corpus
description: Keep durable extracted knowledge connected to changing sources and local work.

interface.shortDescription: Use shared Context and continue local Work files
interface.longDescription: Corpus organizes owner-authenticated durable Context, extracted Source records, and editable Work files into Spaces shared across supported AI clients. Remote records remain usable when a Mac or source is offline; the outbound Sync app follows Finder moves, applies local policy, and delegates parsing to Document Files without exposing a local MCP server.
capabilities: Durable Source record search and captured reading
Exact on-demand Source refresh through the local Sync app
Queued Source and Work job status
Path-independent Source and Work folder identity
Version-checked file replacement, deletion, and restore
defaultPrompt: Show my Corpus Spaces and their available Context and Connections.
Use the relevant Context, then read only the captured Source records still needed.
Continue the Current File in my Corpus Work Connection.
